title: Explore Asia in the Heart of Lisbon & Experience Himalayan Food ( Nepal )
description: ### Walk Through Lisbon & Discover Asia's Hidden Stories **Note**: the walk is **free** as usual. For the food experience we ask a donation on a **sliding scale 5-10 euro** to cover the cost. Experience Lisbon from a different perspective as you explore the city's vibrant Asian communities. Wander through lively neighborhoods, discover family-owned shops, traditional markets, and local restaurants that reflect the rich cultures of Nepal and other Asian countries. Along the way, learn about the history of Asian migration to Portugal, the traditions that have been preserved across generations, and the stories of the people who now call Lisbon home. Meet local entrepreneurs, hear fascinating cultural insights, and experience how Asian heritage has become part of Lisbon's multicultural identity. Complete your journey with an authentic Himalayan dining experience. Savour traditional Nepalese dishes such as handmade momos, aromatic curries, dal bhat, and flavorful Himalayan teas while learning about Nepal's customs, festivals, and warm hospitality. Whether you're a visitor, a food enthusiast, or someone who loves discovering local cultures, this walking experience offers a unique opportunity to explore Lisbon through the eyes of its Asian communities.
